Cluster-pooled, absent-gene rho estimator with per-cell shrinkage.

Source: R/estimate_rho_cluster.R
estimate_rho_cluster.Rd

Cluster-pooled, absent-gene rho estimator with per-cell shrinkage.

Usage

estimate_rho_cluster(
  observed,
  soup,
  clusters,
  alpha = 0.01,
  min_absent_soup = 0.02,
  max_iter = 100,
  min_expected = 5,
  floor_rho = 0.005
)

Arguments

observed

genes x cells counts (base matrix or dgCMatrix).

soup

length-G ambient profile (e.g. from ambient_global()).

clusters

length-cells cluster labels. Prefer a moderate number of reasonably large clusters: very small clusters lose the power to reject weakly-expressed genes and bias rho upward.

alpha

one-sided Poisson level for calling a gene "above soup" (i.e. natively expressed) in a cluster.

min_absent_soup

a cluster whose absent set covers less than this fraction of soup mass is flagged low_power.

max_iter

iteration cap for the absent-set fixed point.

min_expected

a gene can join the absent set only if its expected ambient count in the cluster, at the current rho, is at least this. Below it the Poisson test cannot tell a weakly expressed gene from an absent one, and on real data (tens of thousands of low-count genes) letting those genes in drove rho to several times its true value.

floor_rho

the smallest contamination considered possible. Genes whose total count in the cells is significantly below this fraction of their soup expectation are treated as soup-only and dropped from the soup.

Value

numeric vector of per-cell rho, with attribute "clusters": a data.frame of per-cluster diagnostics (n_cells, rho, n_absent_genes, absent_soup_frac, absent_counts, low_power, borrowed, rho_two_sided), and attributes "soup_mismatch" (logical), "soup_only" (logical per gene) and "soup_only_frac" (their share of the soup). Low-power clusters take the evidence-weighted rho of the other clusters (borrowed = TRUE). soup_mismatch = TRUE means more than 5% of the soup was in genes no cell contains; those genes are dropped, but the empties deserve a look.
